mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) above 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of non-triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) below 1,000,000 signals weak demand in the housing market, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
